evals.name: event-sourcing-setup
evals.prompt: I'm building an inventory service in Go where I need to track stock levels for SKUs across warehouses. Each stock change (received, shipped, adjusted, transferred) must be an immutable audit record so finance can replay history. I want to use event sourcing. My aggregate is a StockItem identified by SKU+warehouse. How do I wire up the decider, command dispatch, and event store? Show me the imports and the minimal wiring so I can persist events and rebuild state.
evals.expected_output: Points to the system composition root (ADR-0123): system.New(ctx, DomainConfig, DeploymentConfig). DomainConfig declares the StockItem aggregate's decider (fold reconstructs state, decide returns events); DeploymentConfig picks the event-store engine. References core.md quickstart (the system.New walkthrough) and recipes.md for the domain pieces. Imports use github.com/larsartmann/go-cqrs-lite/{system,metaengine}/v4. Must NOT hand-wire event/command/decider directly for a new app — those are legacy/migration-only per the skill's hard rule.

evals.name: read-model-projection
evals.prompt: ok so my event-sourced aggregate works but now I need a dashboard showing current stock-on-hand per warehouse, filterable and paginated. I don't want to replay the whole event stream on every page load. What's the go-cqrs-lite way to build a queryable read model from my events? I'm using SQLite in dev and Postgres in prod. Ideally I want server-side filtering on columns like warehouse_id and sku.
evals.expected_output: Routes to readmodels.md and names the metaengine path: declare Query[Q,R] + Store with OnRecord/On folds (AutoCRUDByConvention), wired through the system composition root so auto-projection runs. Engines are a DEPLOYMENT choice via DeploymentConfig — sqlite in dev, postgres in prod, no code change. Server-side filtering/pagination via planned tables (LayoutPlanApplier + BuildLayoutPlanFromType). Mentions ServeSSE[V] for live dashboards. Imports use metaengine/v4. Must NOT recommend stack.Materialize / storage.RelationalProjection as the primary path — those v1 tiers are deprecated and removed in v5.

evals.name: snapshot-schema-evolution
evals.prompt: Our User aggregate has accumulated ~50k events for some power users and loading them on every command is getting slow (200ms+). Also we changed our UserRegistered event payload last quarter and old events still have the old shape. How do I (a) add snapshots so loading is fast, and (b) handle the old event schema without rewriting history? Using go-cqrs-lite.
evals.expected_output: Addresses both via the system + metaengine path: snapshots are a lifecycle concern the system composition root auto-wires (configure via DeploymentConfig); schema evolution uses the schema/ upcasters/transformers to convert old payloads to the new shape on read. Does NOT suggest rewriting/migrating historical events (schema evolution is read-time transformation), and does not hand-wire the snapshot store directly when system.New covers it.
